class Sales::VerificationsController < ApplicationController
  include GaTrackable

  before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
  before_action :authorize_sales
  before_action :set_order
  before_action -> { check_form_stage(:verification_stage) }, only: [ :verification_stage, :verification_stage_submit ]
  before_action :ensure_order_belongs_to_current_user
  before_action :verify_order_status, only: [ :verification_stage_submit, :upload_mou, :resend_upload_documents_email ]

  # GET /portal/sales/orders/:id/verification_stage
  def verification_stage
    @expired = false
    if !@order.verification_expired_at? ||
        Time.now > @order.verification_expired_at ||
        @order.status == "cancelled"

      @order.cancel_order!(cancel_reason: "Verification expired")
      @expired = true
    end

    process_pending_tracking_actions

    render :verification_stage
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/verification_stage_submit
  def verification_stage_submit
    if !@order.verification_expired_at? ||
        Time.now > @order.verification_expired_at ||
        @order.status == "cancelled"
      @order.cancel_order!(cancel_reason: "Verification expired")
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Verification period has expired. Please contact the admin." and return
    end

    # Check if all required documents are attached
    unless Order::DOCUMENT_TYPES.all? { |doc_type| @order.send(doc_type).attached? }
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
                  alert: "The customer must upload all required documents before proceeding to the next step" and return
    end

    # Check if all documents have been approved by the verificator
    unless @order.all_documents_approved?
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
                  alert: "All documents must be approved by the verificator before proceeding to the next step" and return
    end

    redirect_to payment_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Successfully moved to payment stage"
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/upload_mou
  # Handles the upload of MoU document
  def upload_mou
    begin
      if params[:mou_document].present?
        # Validate file type and size
        unless valid_document?(params[:mou_document])
          redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Invalid document format or size. Please upload a JPEG, PDF, DOC, or DOCX file under 10MB."
          return
        end

        @order.mou.attach(params[:mou_document])

        if @order.mou.attached?
          # Find or create document approval for MoU and set status to pending
          document_approval = @order.document_approvals.find_or_initialize_by(document_type: "mou")
          document_approval.status = :pending
          document_approval.note = nil
          document_approval.reviewed_by = nil
          document_approval.save!

          VerificatorMailer.reminder_mou_uploaded(@order).deliver_later

          session[:track_upload_mou] = true

          redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "The MoU document has been successfully uploaded."
        else
          redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to upload the MoU document."
        end
      else
        # If no MoU document is provided, just redirect back without error
        # This handles cases where MoU is already uploaded and form is submitted
        redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
      end
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error uploading MoU document for order ##{@order.id}: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to upload MoU document: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/resend_upload_documents_email
  # Resends the upload documents reminder email with rate limiting
  def resend_upload_documents_email
    Rails.logger.debug("Entering resend_upload_documents_email method for order ##{@order.id}")

    # Rate limit email sending to prevent abuse
    if @order.last_resend_upload_email_at? && @order.last_resend_upload_email_at > 10.minutes.ago
      Rails.logger.debug("Rate limit hit: last email sent at #{@order.last_resend_upload_email_at}")
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You can only resend the email every 10 minutes."
      return
    end

    Rails.logger.debug("Rate limit check passed")
    begin
      Rails.logger.info("Sending reminder upload documents email for order ##{@order.id}")
      SalesMailer.reminder_upload_documents(@order).deliver_later
      @order.update(last_resend_upload_email_at: Time.current)

      session[:track_resend_upload_documents_email] = true

      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Email successfully resent."
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error sending reminder upload documents email: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to send email: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/reorder_verification
  def reorder_verification
    begin
      @order.reorder!

      # Track order retry action
      track_sales_action("click_retry_order",
                         order: @order,
                         custom_params: {
                           page_source: "verification_stage",
                           retry_reason: "verification_reorder"
                         })

      redirect_to msisdn_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
        notice: "Order has been successfully recreated. Please complete the ICCID selection."
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error reordering verification for order ##{@order.id}: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
        alert: "Failed to reorder: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def set_order
    @order = Order.find_by(id: params[:id])
    unless @order
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(current_portal_user), alert: "Order not found."
    end
  end

  def ensure_order_belongs_to_current_user
    unless current_portal_user.has_role?(:admin) || @order.sales_id == current_portal_user.id # ! TODO : USE PUNDIT
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(current_portal_user), alert: "You are not authorized to access this order."
    end
  end

  def verify_order_status
    if @order.complete?
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "This order is already complete and cannot be modified."
    end
  end

  def valid_document?(document)
    content_type = document.content_type
    size = document.size

    valid_types = [ "application/pdf", "image/jpeg", "image/jpg" ]
    max_size = 10.megabytes

    valid_types.include?(content_type) && size <= max_size
  end
end

Perfect! I've successfully refactored the repetitive tracking logic into a clean, maintainable private method. Here's what I did:

## ✅ **Refactoring Summary**

### **Before** (Repetitive Code):
- 28 lines of duplicated session tracking logic
- Hard to maintain and extend
- Mixed concerns within the main method

### **After** (Clean Separation):
- **1 line** in the main method: `process_pending_tracking_actions`
- **35 lines** of well-organized private method
- Easy to maintain and extend

## 🔧 **Key Improvements**

### **1. DRY Principle Applied**
- Eliminated code duplication
- Single point of modification for tracking logic

### **2. Better Data Structure**
```ruby
tracking_actions = [
  {
    session_key: :track_send_data_msisdn,
    action: "click_send_data", 
    custom_params: base_custom_params
  },
  # ... more configurations
]
```

### **3. Smart Parameter Reuse**
- `base_custom_params` for common parameters
- `time_remaining_params` extends base with time info
- Avoids parameter duplication

### **4. Iterator Pattern**
```ruby
tracking_actions.each do |track_config|
  next unless session.delete(track_config[:session_key])
  track_sales_action(track_config[:action], ...)
end
```

## 🚀 **Benefits**

1. **Maintainability**: Adding new tracking actions is now simple - just add to the array
2. **Readability**: Main method is cleaner, private method is self-documenting  
3. **Testability**: Can easily test the private method independently
4. **Consistency**: All tracking actions follow the same pattern
5. **Performance**: No performance impact, same number of operations

The refactored code maintains the exact same functionality while being much cleaner and more maintainable!

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/resend_upload_documents_email
  # Resends the upload documents reminder email with rate limiting
  def resend_upload_documents_email
    Rails.logger.debug("Entering resend_upload_documents_email method for order ##{@order.id}")

    # Rate limit email sending to prevent abuse
    if @order.last_resend_upload_email_at? && @order.last_resend_upload_email_at > 10.minutes.ago
      Rails.logger.debug("Rate limit hit: last email sent at #{@order.last_resend_upload_email_at}")
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You can only resend the email every 10 minutes."
      return
    end

    Rails.logger.debug("Rate limit check passed")
    begin
      Rails.logger.info("Sending reminder upload documents email for order ##{@order.id}")
      SalesMailer.reminder_upload_documents(@order).deliver_later
      @order.update(last_resend_upload_email_at: Time.current)

      session[:track_resend_upload_documents_email] = true

      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Email successfully resent."
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error sending reminder upload documents email: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to send email: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # POST /portal/sales/orders/:id/reorder_verification
  def reorder_verification
    begin
      @order.reorder!

      # Track order retry action
      track_sales_action("click_retry_order",
                         order: @order,
                         custom_params: {
                           page_source: "verification_stage",
                           retry_reason: "verification_reorder"
                         })

      redirect_to msisdn_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
        notice: "Order has been successfully recreated. Please complete the ICCID selection."
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.error("Error reordering verification for order ##{@order.id}: #{e.message}")
      Rails.logger.error(e.backtrace.join("\n"))
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order),
        alert: "Failed to reorder: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  def set_order
    @order = Order.find_by(id: params[:id])
    unless @order
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(current_portal_user), alert: "Order not found."
    end
  end

  def ensure_order_belongs_to_current_user
    unless current_portal_user.has_role?(:admin) || @order.sales_id == current_portal_user.id # ! TODO : USE PUNDIT
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(current_portal_user), alert: "You are not authorized to access this order."
    end
  end

  def verify_order_status
    if @order.complete?
      redirect_to verification_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "This order is already complete and cannot be modified."
    end
  end

  def valid_document?(document)
    content_type = document.content_type
    size = document.size

    valid_types = [ "application/pdf", "image/jpeg", "image/jpg" ]
    max_size = 10.megabytes

    valid_types.include?(content_type) && size <= max_size
  end

  def process_pending_tracking_actions
    base_custom_params = {
      next_page_url: payment_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
    }

    time_remaining_params = base_custom_params.merge(
      time_remaining: @order.verification_expired_at&.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    )

    tracking_actions = [
      {
        session_key: :track_send_data_msisdn,
        action: "click_send_data",
        custom_params: base_custom_params
      },
      {
        session_key: :track_upload_mou,
        action: "click_upload_mou",
        custom_params: time_remaining_params
      },
      {
        session_key: :track_resend_upload_documents_email,
        action: "click_resend_email",
        custom_params: time_remaining_params
      }
    ]

    tracking_actions.each do |track_config|
      next unless session.delete(track_config[:session_key])

      track_sales_action(track_config[:action],
                        order: @order,
                        custom_params: track_config[:custom_params])
    end
  end
end

module Sales
  class DeliveriesController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit, :send_tracking_update, :e_fab, :e_fab_submit ]
    before_action -> { check_form_stage(:delivery_stage) }, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit ]

    def delivery_stage
      if session.delete(:track_delivery_proof_upload)
        # Track delivery proof upload action
        track_sales_action("click_upload_delivery_proof",
                           order: @order,
                           custom_params: {
                             next_page_url: activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
                           })
      end

      if session.delete(:track_e_fab_download)
        # Track e-FAB download action
        track_sales_action("click_download_efab",
                           order: @order,
                           custom_params: {
                             next_page_url: activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
                           })
      end
    end

    def delivery_stage_submit
      # Process delivery submission
      if @order.update(delivery_params)
        # Check if FAB and delivery proof are attached
        if @order.fab.attached? && @order.delivery_proof.attached?
          @order.form_stage = :activation_stage
          @order.save!

          # Track delivery confirmation
          track_sales_action("click_delivery_confirmation",
                             order: @order,
                             custom_params: {
                               page_source: "delivery_stage",
                               next_stage: "activation_stage"
                             })

          # Move directly to activation stage without sending email
          redirect_to activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Successfully completed delivery stage"
        else
          missing_attachments = missing_attachments(@order)
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Missing required attachments: #{missing_attachments.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        Rails.logger.error "Delivery Update Failed: #{@order.errors.full_messages}"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to update delivery information: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    def send_tracking_update
      # Verify agreement checkbox is checked
      unless delivery_params[:agreement] == "1"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You must agree to the terms before sending tracking update."
        return
      end

      # Check if delivery proof is attached
      if delivery_params[:delivery_proof].present?
        @order.delivery_proof.attach(delivery_params[:delivery_proof])

        begin
          @order.save!

          # Send tracking update email with minimal logging
          Rails.logger.info "Sending tracking update email for Order ID: #{@order.id}"
          DeliveryMailer.delivery_notification_email(@order).deliver_later

          session[:track_delivery_proof_upload] = true

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Tracking update email has been sent successfully."
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to save delivery proof: #{e.message}"
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to save delivery proof: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        rescue StandardError => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to save delivery proof: #{e.message}"
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to save delivery proof: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Delivery proof is required."
      end
    end

    def e_fab
      session.delete(:track_e_fab_download)

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "e_fab_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/e-fab",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8"
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to e_fab_portal_sales_order_path(@order, format: :html), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    def e_fab_submit
      if params[:fab].present?
        @order.fab.attach(params[:fab])

        if @order.save
          Rails.logger.info "e-FAB document submitted successfully for Order ID: #{@order.id}"

          # Track FAB upload
          track_sales_action("click_upload_fab",
                             order: @order,
                             custom_params: {
                               page_source: "delivery_stage",
                               document_type: "e_fab"
                             })

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "e-FAB document has been submitted successfully."
        else
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to submit e-FAB document: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "e-FAB document is required."
      end
    end

    def transaction_receipt
      @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])

      # Track receipt download
      if params[:format] == "pdf"
        track_sales_action("click_download_receipt",
                           order: @order,
                           custom_params: {
                             page_source: "activation_stage",
                             document_type: "transaction_receipt"
                           })
      end

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "transaction_receipt_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/transaction_receipt",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8",
                 show_as_html: params.key?("debug")
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end

      def delivery_params
        params.permit(:delivery_proof, :agreement)
      end

      def missing_attachments(order)
        [].tap do |list|
          list << "FAB" unless order.fab.attached?
          list << "Delivery Proof" unless order.delivery_proof.attached?
        end
      end
  end
end

module Sales
  class DeliveriesController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit, :send_tracking_update, :e_fab, :e_fab_submit ]
    before_action -> { check_form_stage(:delivery_stage) }, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit ]

    def delivery_stage
      process_pending_tracking_actions
    end

    def delivery_stage_submit
      # Process delivery submission
      if @order.update(delivery_params)
        # Check if FAB and delivery proof are attached
        if @order.fab.attached? && @order.delivery_proof.attached?
          @order.form_stage = :activation_stage
          @order.save!

          # Track delivery confirmation
          track_sales_action("click_delivery_confirmation",
                             order: @order,
                             custom_params: {
                               page_source: "delivery_stage",
                               next_stage: "activation_stage"
                             })

          # Move directly to activation stage without sending email
          redirect_to activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Successfully completed delivery stage"
        else
          missing_attachments = missing_attachments(@order)
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Missing required attachments: #{missing_attachments.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        Rails.logger.error "Delivery Update Failed: #{@order.errors.full_messages}"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to update delivery information: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
      end
    end

    def send_tracking_update
      # Verify agreement checkbox is checked
      unless delivery_params[:agreement] == "1"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You must agree to the terms before sending tracking update."
        return
      end

      # Check if delivery proof is attached
      if delivery_params[:delivery_proof].present?
        @order.delivery_proof.attach(delivery_params[:delivery_proof])

        begin
          @order.save!

          # Send tracking update email with minimal logging
          Rails.logger.info "Sending tracking update email for Order ID: #{@order.id}"
          DeliveryMailer.delivery_notification_email(@order).deliver_later

          session[:track_delivery_proof_upload] = true

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Tracking update email has been sent successfully."
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to save delivery proof: #{e.message}"
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to save delivery proof: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        rescue StandardError => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to save delivery proof: #{e.message}"
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to save delivery proof: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Delivery proof is required."
      end
    end

    def e_fab
      session.delete(:track_e_fab_download)

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "e_fab_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/e-fab",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8"
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to e_fab_portal_sales_order_path(@order, format: :html), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    def e_fab_submit
      if params[:fab].present?
        @order.fab.attach(params[:fab])

        if @order.save
          Rails.logger.info "e-FAB document submitted successfully for Order ID: #{@order.id}"

          # Track FAB upload
          track_sales_action("click_upload_fab",
                             order: @order,
                             custom_params: {
                               page_source: "delivery_stage",
                               document_type: "e_fab"
                             })

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "e-FAB document has been submitted successfully."
        else
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to submit e-FAB document: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "e-FAB document is required."
      end
    end

    def transaction_receipt
      @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])

      # Track receipt download
      if params[:format] == "pdf"
        track_sales_action("click_download_receipt",
                           order: @order,
                           custom_params: {
                             page_source: "activation_stage",
                             document_type: "transaction_receipt"
                           })
      end

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "transaction_receipt_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/transaction_receipt",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8",
                 show_as_html: params.key?("debug")
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end

      def delivery_params
        params.permit(:delivery_proof, :agreement)
      end

      def missing_attachments(order)
        [].tap do |list|
          list << "FAB" unless order.fab.attached?
          list << "Delivery Proof" unless order.delivery_proof.attached?
        end
      end
  end
end

module Sales
  class DeliveriesController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit, :send_tracking_update, :e_fab, :e_fab_submit ]
    before_action -> { check_form_stage(:delivery_stage) }, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit ]

    def delivery_stage
      process_pending_tracking_actions
    end

    def delivery_stage_submit
      # Process delivery submission
      if @order.update(delivery_params)
        # Check if FAB and delivery proof are attached
        if @order.fab.attached? && @order.delivery_proof.attached?
          complete_delivery_stage
        else
          handle_missing_attachments
        end
      else
        handle_delivery_update_failure
      end
    end

    def send_tracking_update
      # Verify agreement checkbox is checked
      unless delivery_params[:agreement] == "1"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You must agree to the terms before sending tracking update."
        return
      end

      # Check if delivery proof is attached
      if delivery_params[:delivery_proof].present?
        process_delivery_proof_upload
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Delivery proof is required."
      end
    end

    def e_fab
      session[:track_e_fab_download] = true

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "e_fab_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/e-fab",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8"
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to e_fab_portal_sales_order_path(@order, format: :html), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    def e_fab_submit
      if params[:fab].present?
        @order.fab.attach(params[:fab])

        if @order.save
          Rails.logger.info "e-FAB document submitted successfully for Order ID: #{@order.id}"

          session[:track_e_fab_upload] = true

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "e-FAB document has been submitted successfully."
        else
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to submit e-FAB document: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "e-FAB document is required."
      end
    end

    def transaction_receipt
      @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])

      session[:track_receipt_download] = true

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "transaction_receipt_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/transaction_receipt",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8",
                 show_as_html: params.key?("debug")
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end

      def delivery_params
        params.permit(:delivery_proof, :agreement)
      end

      def missing_attachments(order)
        [].tap do |list|
          list << "FAB" unless order.fab.attached?
          list << "Delivery Proof" unless order.delivery_proof.attached?
        end
      end

      def complete_delivery_stage
        @order.form_stage = :activation_stage
        @order.save!

        session[:track_delivery_confirmation] = true

        # Move directly to activation stage without sending email
        redirect_to activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Successfully completed delivery stage"
      end

      def handle_missing_attachments
        missing_list = missing_attachments(@order)
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Missing required attachments: #{missing_list.join(', ')}"
      end

      def handle_delivery_update_failure
        Rails.logger.error "Delivery Update Failed: #{@order.errors.full_messages}"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to update delivery information: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
      end

      def process_pending_tracking_actions
        activation_page_url = activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)

        tracking_actions = [
          {
            session_key: :track_delivery_proof_upload,
            action: "click_upload_delivery_proof",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          },
          {
            session_key: :track_e_fab_download,
            action: "click_download_fab_template",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          },
          {
            session_key: :track_e_fab_upload,
            action: "click_upload_fab",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          },
          {
            session_key: :track_receipt_download,
            action: "click_download_receipt",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          }
        ]

        tracking_actions.each do |track_config|
          next unless session.delete(track_config[:session_key])

          track_sales_action(track_config[:action],
                            order: @order,
                            custom_params: track_config[:custom_params])
        end
      end
  end
end

module Sales
  class DeliveriesController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit, :send_tracking_update, :e_fab, :e_fab_submit ]
    before_action -> { check_form_stage(:delivery_stage) }, only: [ :delivery_stage, :delivery_stage_submit ]

    def delivery_stage
      process_pending_tracking_actions
    end

    def delivery_stage_submit
      # Process delivery submission
      if @order.update(delivery_params)
        # Check if FAB and delivery proof are attached
        if @order.fab.attached? && @order.delivery_proof.attached?
          complete_delivery_stage
        else
          handle_missing_attachments
        end
      else
        handle_delivery_update_failure
      end
    end

    def send_tracking_update
      # Verify agreement checkbox is checked
      unless delivery_params[:agreement] == "1"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "You must agree to the terms before sending tracking update."
        return
      end

      # Check if delivery proof is attached
      if delivery_params[:delivery_proof].present?
        process_delivery_proof_upload
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Delivery proof is required."
      end
    end

    def e_fab
      session[:track_e_fab_download] = true

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "e_fab_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/e-fab",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8"
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to e_fab_portal_sales_order_path(@order, format: :html), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    def e_fab_submit
      if params[:fab].present?
        @order.fab.attach(params[:fab])

        if @order.save
          Rails.logger.info "e-FAB document submitted successfully for Order ID: #{@order.id}"

          session[:track_e_fab_upload] = true

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "e-FAB document has been submitted successfully."
        else
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to submit e-FAB document: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      else
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "e-FAB document is required."
      end
    end

    # GET /portal/sales/orders/:id/transaction_receipt
    # Used in delivery_stage.html.erb for PDF download link
    def transaction_receipt
      @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])

      session[:track_receipt_download] = true

      respond_to do |format|
        format.html
        format.pdf do
          render pdf: "transaction_receipt_#{@order.order_reference_number}",
                 template: "sales/deliveries/transaction_receipt",
                 layout: "pdf",
                 formats: [ :html ],
                 disposition: "inline",
                 encoding: "UTF-8",
                 show_as_html: params.key?("debug")
        end
      end
    rescue ActionController::UnknownFormat => e
      Rails.logger.error("PDF format error: #{e.message}")
      redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Unable to generate PDF. Please try again."
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.includes(order_items: :product).find(params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end

      def delivery_params
        params.permit(:delivery_proof, :agreement)
      end

      def missing_attachments(order)
        [].tap do |list|
          list << "FAB" unless order.fab.attached?
          list << "Delivery Proof" unless order.delivery_proof.attached?
        end
      end

      def complete_delivery_stage
        @order.form_stage = :activation_stage
        @order.save!

        session[:track_delivery_confirmation] = true

        # Move directly to activation stage without sending email
        redirect_to activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Successfully completed delivery stage"
      end

      def handle_missing_attachments
        missing_list = missing_attachments(@order)
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Missing required attachments: #{missing_list.join(', ')}"
      end

      def handle_delivery_update_failure
        Rails.logger.error "Delivery Update Failed: #{@order.errors.full_messages}"
        redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to update delivery information: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
      end

      def process_delivery_proof_upload
        @order.delivery_proof.attach(delivery_params[:delivery_proof])

        begin
          @order.save!

          # Send tracking update email with minimal logging
          Rails.logger.info "Sending tracking update email for Order ID: #{@order.id}"
          DeliveryMailer.delivery_notification_email(@order).deliver_later

          session[:track_delivery_proof_upload] = true

          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), notice: "Tracking update email has been sent successfully."
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to save delivery proof: #{e.message}"
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to save delivery proof: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        rescue StandardError => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to save delivery proof: #{e.message}"
          redirect_to delivery_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order), alert: "Failed to save delivery proof: #{@order.errors.full_messages.join(', ')}"
        end
      end

      def process_pending_tracking_actions
        activation_page_url = activation_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)

        tracking_actions = [
          {
            session_key: :track_delivery_proof_upload,
            action: "click_upload_delivery_proof",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          },
          {
            session_key: :track_e_fab_download,
            action: "click_download_fab_template",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          },
          {
            session_key: :track_e_fab_upload,
            action: "click_upload_fab",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          },
          {
            session_key: :track_receipt_download,
            action: "click_download_receipt",
            custom_params: {
              next_page_url: activation_page_url
            }
          }
        ]

        tracking_actions.each do |track_config|
          next unless session.delete(track_config[:session_key])

          track_sales_action(track_config[:action],
                            order: @order,
                            custom_params: track_config[:custom_params])
        end
      end
  end
end

require 'rails_helper'

RSpec.describe "Users::Sessions", type: :request do
  include Devise::Test::IntegrationHelpers

  let!(:user) do
    create(:portal_user,
      email: "user@example.com",
      password: "Aa1@aaaa",
      password_confirmation: "Aa1@aaaa",
      verified: true
    )
  end

  describe "POST /portal/users/sign_in" do
    context "when email is not found" do
      it "redirects with 'Email not found' flash" do
        post portal_user_session_path, params: {
          portal_user: {
            email: "wrong@example.com",
            password: "Aa1@aaaa"
          }
        }
        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Email not found")
      end
    end

    context "when user is not verified" do
      before { user.update!(verified: false) }

      it "redirects with 'account not verified' flash" do
        post portal_user_session_path, params: {
          portal_user: {
            email: user.email,
            password: "Aa1@aaaa"
          }
        }
        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
        follow_redirect!
        expect(response.body).to include("Your account hasn't been verified. Please follow the link sent to your email")
      end

<%# General Google Analytics Event Tracking %>
<%# This partial handles server-side GA events set by controllers %>
<%# Controllers should set @ga_events as an array of event hashes %>

<% if defined?(@ga_events) && @ga_events.present? %>
  <% @ga_events.each do |event| %>
    <% 
      # Extract standard parameters
      standard_params = event.slice(:category, :label, :value)
      # Get custom parameters (everything except action and standard params)
      custom_params = event.except(:action, :category, :label, :value)
    %>
    <%= track_event(
      event[:action], 
      **standard_params,
      **custom_params
    ) %>
  <% end %>
<% end %>

<%# Legacy support for authentication-specific events %>
<%# TODO: Migrate these to use @ga_events in future refactoring %>
<% if defined?(@ga_login_success) && @ga_login_success.present? %>
  <%= track_event(@ga_login_success[:action], 
                  category: @ga_login_success[:category], 
                  label: @ga_login_success[:label]) %>
<% end %>

<% if defined?(@ga_signup_success) && @ga_signup_success.present? %>
  <%= track_event(@ga_signup_success[:action], 
                  category: @ga_signup_success[:category], 
                  label: @ga_signup_success[:label]) %>
<% end %>

<% if defined?(@ga_logout) && @ga_logout.present? %>
  <%= track_event(@ga_logout[:action], 
                  category: @ga_logout[:category], 
                  label: @ga_logout[:label]) %>
<% end %>

module GaTrackable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    helper GoogleAnalyticsHelper
  end

  private

  # Add a single GA event to be tracked
  # @param action [String] The action name (e.g., 'login', 'purchase', 'signup')
  # @param category [String] The event category (e.g., 'authentication', 'ecommerce')
  # @param label [String, nil] Optional label for the event
  # @param value [Integer, nil] Optional numeric value for the event
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_ga_event(action, category:, label: nil, value: nil, custom_params: {})
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events << {
      action: action,
      category: category,
      label: label,
      value: value
    }.compact.merge(custom_params)
  end

  # Add multiple GA events at once
  # @param events [Array<Hash>] Array of event hashes
  def track_ga_events(events)
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events.concat(events)
  end

  # Track a successful authentication event
  # @param action [String] The authentication action ('login', 'signup', 'logout')
  # @param user [User] The user object (optional)
  def track_authentication(action, user: nil)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    # Get the user's role name, capitalize it properly
    role_name = if user&.roles&.first&.name
      case user.roles.first.name
      when "admin" then "Admin"
      when "sales" then "Sales"
      when "customer" then "Customer"
      when "verificator" then "Verificator"
      else user.roles.first.name.capitalize
      end
    else
      "Unknown"
    end

    # Send event with category: authentication, action: login/logout, label: role
    track_ga_event(action, category: "authentication", label: role_name)
  end

  # Track a form submission
  # @param form_name [String] Name of the form
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the submission was successful
  def track_form_submission(form_name, success: true)
    action = success ? "form_success" : "form_error"
    track_ga_event(action, category: "forms", label: form_name)
  end

  # Track a purchase or order event
  # @param order_id [String] The order identifier
  # @param value [Integer] The order value
  # @param label [String] Additional label (e.g., product category)
  def track_purchase(order_id, value: nil, label: nil)
    track_ga_event("purchase",
                   category: "ecommerce",
                   label: label || order_id,
                   value: value)
  end

  # Track page navigation events
  # @param page_name [String] Name of the page or section
  # @param action [String] The navigation action (default: 'view')
  def track_page_navigation(page_name, action: "view")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "navigation", label: page_name)
  end

  # Track user interactions
  # @param element [String] The UI element interacted with
  # @param action [String] The interaction type (click, hover, etc.)
  def track_interaction(element, action: "click")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "interaction", label: element)
  end

  # Track errors or exceptions
  # @param error_message [String] Description of the error
  # @param fatal [Boolean] Whether the error is fatal
  def track_error(error_message, fatal: false)
    label = fatal ? "fatal_error" : "error"
    track_ga_event("exception", category: "errors", label: "#{label}: #{error_message}")
  end

  # Track search queries
  # @param query [String] The search query
  # @param results_count [Integer] Number of results found
  def track_search(query, results_count: nil)
    track_ga_event("search",
                   category: "search",
                   label: query,
                   value: results_count)
  end

  # Track file downloads
  # @param filename [String] Name of the downloaded file
  # @param file_type [String] Type of file (pdf, xlsx, etc.)
  def track_download(filename, file_type: nil)
    label = file_type ? "#{file_type}: #{filename}" : filename
    track_ga_event("download", category: "downloads", label: label)
  end

  # Track API calls
  # @param endpoint [String] The API endpoint
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the API call was successful
  # @param response_time [Integer] Response time in milliseconds
  def track_api_call(endpoint, success: true, response_time: nil)
    action = success ? "api_success" : "api_error"
    track_ga_event(action,
                   category: "api",
                   label: endpoint,
                   value: response_time)
  end

  # Track sales workflow actions with standardized parameters
  # @param action [String] The sales action (e.g., 'click_order_now', 'click_send_data')
  # @param order [Order] The order object for event label
  # @param product_name [String] The product name for event value
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_sales_action(action, order:, product_name: nil, custom_params: {})
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    begin
      track_ga_event(action,
                     category: "sales_lifecycle",
                     label: order&.id,
                     value: product_name,
                     custom_params: custom_params)
      Rails.logger.info "Sales GA tracking: #{action} for Order ##{order&.id}"
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Sales GA tracking failed for #{action}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  # Check if Google Analytics is enabled and not in test environment
  # @return [Boolean] Whether GA tracking should be performed
  def google_analytics_enabled?
    defined?(Rails) &&
    Rails.application.config.respond_to?(:google_analytics_enabled) &&
    Rails.application.config.google_analytics_enabled &&
    !Rails.env.test?
  end
end

## Analysis of Rails Best Practices Violations

### 1. **Why rails_best_practices flags this as an issue**

Rails best practices flags the use of instance variables in partials for several key reasons:

- **Tight Coupling**: Instance variables create implicit dependencies between controllers and views, making the partial less reusable and harder to test
- **Hidden Dependencies**: Instance variables make it unclear what data a partial expects, reducing code clarity
- **Violation of Explicit Interface Principle**: Partials should have explicit parameters rather than relying on controller state
- **Testing Complexity**: Testing partials with instance variables requires setting up controller state instead of just passing parameters

### 2. **Best Practices for Passing Data to Partial Views**

The Rails way for partials is to use **local variables** passed explicitly:

```ruby
# Good: Explicit parameters
<%= render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: @ga_events %>

# Bad: Implicit instance variables
<%= render 'shared/ga_events' %>
```

### 3. **Recommended Refactoring Approach**

Here's my recommended solution that maintains functionality while following Rails conventions:

module GaTrackable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    helper GoogleAnalyticsHelper
  end

  private

  # Add a single GA event to be tracked
  # @param action [String] The action name (e.g., 'login', 'purchase', 'signup')
  # @param category [String] The event category (e.g., 'authentication', 'ecommerce')
  # @param label [String, nil] Optional label for the event
  # @param value [Integer, nil] Optional numeric value for the event
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_ga_event(action, category:, label: nil, value: nil, custom_params: {})
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events << {
      action: action,
      category: category,
      label: label,
      value: value
    }.compact.merge(custom_params)
  end

  # Add multiple GA events at once
  # @param events [Array<Hash>] Array of event hashes
  def track_ga_events(events)
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events.concat(events)
  end

  # Track a successful authentication event
  # @param action [String] The authentication action ('login', 'signup', 'logout')
  # @param user [User] The user object (optional)
  def track_authentication(action, user: nil)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    # Get the user's role name, capitalize it properly
    role_name = if user&.roles&.first&.name
      case user.roles.first.name
      when "admin" then "Admin"
      when "sales" then "Sales"
      when "customer" then "Customer"
      when "verificator" then "Verificator"
      else user.roles.first.name.capitalize
      end
    else
      "Unknown"
    end

    # Send event with category: authentication, action: login/logout, label: role
    track_ga_event(action, category: "authentication", label: role_name)
  end

  # Track a form submission
  # @param form_name [String] Name of the form
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the submission was successful
  def track_form_submission(form_name, success: true)
    action = success ? "form_success" : "form_error"
    track_ga_event(action, category: "forms", label: form_name)
  end

  # Track a purchase or order event
  # @param order_id [String] The order identifier
  # @param value [Integer] The order value
  # @param label [String] Additional label (e.g., product category)
  def track_purchase(order_id, value: nil, label: nil)
    track_ga_event("purchase",
                   category: "ecommerce",
                   label: label || order_id,
                   value: value)
  end

  # Track page navigation events
  # @param page_name [String] Name of the page or section
  # @param action [String] The navigation action (default: 'view')
  def track_page_navigation(page_name, action: "view")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "navigation", label: page_name)
  end

  # Track user interactions
  # @param element [String] The UI element interacted with
  # @param action [String] The interaction type (click, hover, etc.)
  def track_interaction(element, action: "click")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "interaction", label: element)
  end

  # Track errors or exceptions
  # @param error_message [String] Description of the error
  # @param fatal [Boolean] Whether the error is fatal
  def track_error(error_message, fatal: false)
    label = fatal ? "fatal_error" : "error"
    track_ga_event("exception", category: "errors", label: "#{label}: #{error_message}")
  end

  # Track search queries
  # @param query [String] The search query
  # @param results_count [Integer] Number of results found
  def track_search(query, results_count: nil)
    track_ga_event("search",
                   category: "search",
                   label: query,
                   value: results_count)
  end

  # Track file downloads
  # @param filename [String] Name of the downloaded file
  # @param file_type [String] Type of file (pdf, xlsx, etc.)
  def track_download(filename, file_type: nil)
    label = file_type ? "#{file_type}: #{filename}" : filename
    track_ga_event("download", category: "downloads", label: label)
  end

  # Track API calls
  # @param endpoint [String] The API endpoint
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the API call was successful
  # @param response_time [Integer] Response time in milliseconds
  def track_api_call(endpoint, success: true, response_time: nil)
    action = success ? "api_success" : "api_error"
    track_ga_event(action,
                   category: "api",
                   label: endpoint,
                   value: response_time)
  end

  # Track sales workflow actions with standardized parameters
  # @param action [String] The sales action (e.g., 'click_order_now', 'click_send_data')
  # @param order [Order] The order object for event label
  # @param product_name [String] The product name for event value
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_sales_action(action, order:, product_name: nil, custom_params: {})
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    begin
      track_ga_event(action,
                     category: "sales_lifecycle",
                     label: order&.id,
                     value: product_name,
                     custom_params: custom_params)
      Rails.logger.info "Sales GA tracking: #{action} for Order ##{order&.id}"
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Sales GA tracking failed for #{action}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  private

  # Check if Google Analytics is enabled and not in test environment
  # @return [Boolean] Whether GA tracking should be performed
  def google_analytics_enabled?
    defined?(Rails) &&
    Rails.application.config.respond_to?(:google_analytics_enabled) &&
    Rails.application.config.google_analytics_enabled &&
    !Rails.env.test?
  end
end

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Google Analytics Authentication Tracking", type: :request do
  let(:user) { create(:portal_user, :admin, verified: true) }

  before do
    allow(Rails.application.config).to receive_messages(google_analytics_enabled: true, google_analytics_id: "GA-123456789")
  end

  describe "Login tracking" do
    context "when login is successful" do
      it "sets up GA tracking data" do
        post portal_user_session_path, params: {
          portal_user: {
            email: user.email,
            password: user.password
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(portal_admin_dashboard_path)
        expect(assigns(:ga_events)).to be_present
        expect(assigns(:ga_events).first[:action]).to eq("login")
        expect(assigns(:ga_events).first[:category]).to eq("authentication")
      end
    end

    context "when login fails" do
      it "does not set GA success tracking data" do
        post portal_user_session_path, params: {
          portal_user: {
            email: user.email,
            password: "wrong_password"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
        expect(assigns(:ga_events)).to be_nil
      end
    end
  end

  describe "First login tracking" do
    let(:unverified_user) { create(:portal_user, verified: false, login_token: SecureRandom.hex(32), login_token_expired_at: 1.day.from_now) }

    context "when password setup is successful" do
      it "sets up GA signup success tracking data" do
        post first_login_portal_user_path, params: {
          portal_user: {
            token: unverified_user.login_token,
            password: "NewPassword123!",
            password_confirmation: "NewPassword123!"
          }
        }

        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
        expect(assigns(:ga_events)).to be_present
        expect(assigns(:ga_events).first[:action]).to eq("signup_complete")
        expect(assigns(:ga_events).first[:category]).to eq("authentication")
      end
    end

    context "when password setup fails" do
      it "does not set GA success tracking data" do
        post first_login_portal_user_path, params: {
          portal_user: {
            token: unverified_user.login_token,
            password: "",
            password_confirmation: ""
          }
        }

        expect(assigns(:ga_events)).to be_nil
      end
    end
  end

  describe "Logout tracking" do
    before { sign_in user }

    it "sets up GA logout tracking data" do
      delete destroy_portal_user_session_path

      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_portal_user_session_path)
      expect(assigns(:ga_events)).to be_present
      expect(assigns(:ga_events).first[:action]).to eq("logout")
      expect(assigns(:ga_events).first[:category]).to eq("authentication")
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

class Users::SessionsController < Devise::SessionsController
  include GaTrackable
  def create
    if params[:portal_user].present?
      user = PortalUser.find_by(email: params[:portal_user][:email])
      password = params[:portal_user][:password]
    end

    if user.nil?
      flash[:alert] = "Email not found"
      redirect_to new_portal_user_session_path
    elsif !user.verified?
      flash[:alert] = "Your account hasn't been verified. Please follow the link sent to your email."
      redirect_to new_portal_user_session_path
    elsif !user.valid_password?(password)
      flash[:alert] = "Incorrect password"
      redirect_to new_portal_user_session_path
    else
      flash[:notice] = "Login successful!"
      sign_in(:portal_user, user)

      # Track successful login
      track_authentication("login", user: user)

      # Redirect based on role
      redirect_to redirect_based_on_role(user)
    end
  end

  def destroy
    # Track logout before signing out
    track_authentication("logout", user: current_portal_user)

    sign_out(resource_name)
    flash[:notice] = "Signed out successfully"
    redirect_to after_sign_out_path_for(resource_name)
  end

  def after_sign_out_path_for(resource_or_scope)
    new_portal_user_session_path
  end
end

module GaTrackable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    helper GoogleAnalyticsHelper
  end

  private

  # Add a single GA event to be tracked
  # @param action [String] The action name (e.g., 'login', 'purchase', 'signup')
  # @param category [String] The event category (e.g., 'authentication', 'ecommerce')
  # @param label [String, nil] Optional label for the event
  # @param value [Integer, nil] Optional numeric value for the event
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_ga_event(action, category:, label: nil, value: nil, custom_params: {})
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events << {
      action: action,
      category: category,
      label: label,
      value: value
    }.compact.merge(custom_params)
  end

  # Add multiple GA events at once
  # @param events [Array<Hash>] Array of event hashes
  def track_ga_events(events)
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events.concat(events)
  end

  # Track a successful authentication event
  # @param action [String] The authentication action ('login', 'signup', 'logout')
  # @param user [User] The user object (optional)
  def track_authentication(action, user: nil)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    # Get the user's role name, capitalize it properly
    role_name = if user&.roles&.first&.name
      case user.roles.first.name
      when "admin" then "Admin"
      when "sales" then "Sales"
      when "customer" then "Customer"
      when "verificator" then "Verificator"
      else user.roles.first.name.capitalize
      end
    else
      "Unknown"
    end

    # Send event with category: authentication, action: login/logout, label: role
    track_ga_event(action, category: "authentication", label: role_name)
  end

  # Track a form submission
  # @param form_name [String] Name of the form
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the submission was successful
  def track_form_submission(form_name, success: true)
    action = success ? "form_success" : "form_error"
    track_ga_event(action, category: "forms", label: form_name)
  end

  # Track a purchase or order event
  # @param order_id [String] The order identifier
  # @param value [Integer] The order value
  # @param label [String] Additional label (e.g., product category)
  def track_purchase(order_id, value: nil, label: nil)
    track_ga_event("purchase",
                   category: "ecommerce",
                   label: label || order_id,
                   value: value)
  end

  # Track page navigation events
  # @param page_name [String] Name of the page or section
  # @param action [String] The navigation action (default: 'view')
  def track_page_navigation(page_name, action: "view")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "navigation", label: page_name)
  end

  # Track user interactions
  # @param element [String] The UI element interacted with
  # @param action [String] The interaction type (click, hover, etc.)
  def track_interaction(element, action: "click")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "interaction", label: element)
  end

  # Track errors or exceptions
  # @param error_message [String] Description of the error
  # @param fatal [Boolean] Whether the error is fatal
  def track_error(error_message, fatal: false)
    label = fatal ? "fatal_error" : "error"
    track_ga_event("exception", category: "errors", label: "#{label}: #{error_message}")
  end

  # Track search queries
  # @param query [String] The search query
  # @param results_count [Integer] Number of results found
  def track_search(query, results_count: nil)
    track_ga_event("search",
                   category: "search",
                   label: query,
                   value: results_count)
  end

  # Track file downloads
  # @param filename [String] Name of the downloaded file
  # @param file_type [String] Type of file (pdf, xlsx, etc.)
  def track_download(filename, file_type: nil)
    label = file_type ? "#{file_type}: #{filename}" : filename
    track_ga_event("download", category: "downloads", label: label)
  end

  # Track API calls
  # @param endpoint [String] The API endpoint
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the API call was successful
  # @param response_time [Integer] Response time in milliseconds
  def track_api_call(endpoint, success: true, response_time: nil)
    action = success ? "api_success" : "api_error"
    track_ga_event(action,
                   category: "api",
                   label: endpoint,
                   value: response_time)
  end

  # Track sales workflow actions with standardized parameters
  # @param action [String] The sales action (e.g., 'click_order_now', 'click_send_data')
  # @param order [Order] The order object for event label
  # @param product_name [String] The product name for event value
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_sales_action(action, order:, product_name: nil, custom_params: {})
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    begin
      track_ga_event(action,
                     category: "sales_lifecycle",
                     label: order&.id,
                     value: product_name,
                     custom_params: custom_params)
      Rails.logger.info "Sales GA tracking: #{action} for Order ##{order&.id}"
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Sales GA tracking failed for #{action}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # Public method to get GA events for view rendering
  # This provides a clean interface for views to access GA events
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Array of GA event hashes, never nil
  def ga_events_for_rendering
    @ga_events ||= []
  end

  private

  # Check if Google Analytics is enabled and not in test environment
  # @return [Boolean] Whether GA tracking should be performed
  def google_analytics_enabled?
    defined?(Rails) &&
    Rails.application.config.respond_to?(:google_analytics_enabled) &&
    Rails.application.config.google_analytics_enabled &&
    !Rails.env.test?
  end
end

module GaTrackable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    helper GoogleAnalyticsHelper
  end

  private

  # Add a single GA event to be tracked
  # @param action [String] The action name (e.g., 'login', 'purchase', 'signup')
  # @param category [String] The event category (e.g., 'authentication', 'ecommerce')
  # @param label [String, nil] Optional label for the event
  # @param value [Integer, nil] Optional numeric value for the event
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_ga_event(action, category:, label: nil, value: nil, custom_params: {})
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events << {
      action: action,
      category: category,
      label: label,
      value: value
    }.compact.merge(custom_params)
  end

  # Add multiple GA events at once
  # @param events [Array<Hash>] Array of event hashes
  def track_ga_events(events)
    @ga_events ||= []
    @ga_events.concat(events)
  end

  # Track a successful authentication event
  # @param action [String] The authentication action ('login', 'signup', 'logout')
  # @param user [User] The user object (optional)
  def track_authentication(action, user: nil)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    # Get the user's role name, capitalize it properly
    role_name = if user&.roles&.first&.name
      case user.roles.first.name
      when "admin" then "Admin"
      when "sales" then "Sales"
      when "customer" then "Customer"
      when "verificator" then "Verificator"
      else user.roles.first.name.capitalize
      end
    else
      "Unknown"
    end

    # Send event with category: authentication, action: login/logout, label: role
    track_ga_event(action, category: "authentication", label: role_name)
  end

  # Track a form submission
  # @param form_name [String] Name of the form
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the submission was successful
  def track_form_submission(form_name, success: true)
    action = success ? "form_success" : "form_error"
    track_ga_event(action, category: "forms", label: form_name)
  end

  # Track a purchase or order event
  # @param order_id [String] The order identifier
  # @param value [Integer] The order value
  # @param label [String] Additional label (e.g., product category)
  def track_purchase(order_id, value: nil, label: nil)
    track_ga_event("purchase",
                   category: "ecommerce",
                   label: label || order_id,
                   value: value)
  end

  # Track page navigation events
  # @param page_name [String] Name of the page or section
  # @param action [String] The navigation action (default: 'view')
  def track_page_navigation(page_name, action: "view")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "navigation", label: page_name)
  end

  # Track user interactions
  # @param element [String] The UI element interacted with
  # @param action [String] The interaction type (click, hover, etc.)
  def track_interaction(element, action: "click")
    track_ga_event(action, category: "interaction", label: element)
  end

  # Track errors or exceptions
  # @param error_message [String] Description of the error
  # @param fatal [Boolean] Whether the error is fatal
  def track_error(error_message, fatal: false)
    label = fatal ? "fatal_error" : "error"
    track_ga_event("exception", category: "errors", label: "#{label}: #{error_message}")
  end

  # Track search queries
  # @param query [String] The search query
  # @param results_count [Integer] Number of results found
  def track_search(query, results_count: nil)
    track_ga_event("search",
                   category: "search",
                   label: query,
                   value: results_count)
  end

  # Track file downloads
  # @param filename [String] Name of the downloaded file
  # @param file_type [String] Type of file (pdf, xlsx, etc.)
  def track_download(filename, file_type: nil)
    label = file_type ? "#{file_type}: #{filename}" : filename
    track_ga_event("download", category: "downloads", label: label)
  end

  # Track API calls
  # @param endpoint [String] The API endpoint
  # @param success [Boolean] Whether the API call was successful
  # @param response_time [Integer] Response time in milliseconds
  def track_api_call(endpoint, success: true, response_time: nil)
    action = success ? "api_success" : "api_error"
    track_ga_event(action,
                   category: "api",
                   label: endpoint,
                   value: response_time)
  end

  # Track sales workflow actions with standardized parameters
  # @param action [String] The sales action (e.g., 'click_order_now', 'click_send_data')
  # @param order [Order] The order object for event label
  # @param product_name [String] The product name for event value
  # @param custom_params [Hash] Additional custom parameters for the event
  def track_sales_action(action, order:, product_name: nil, custom_params: {})
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    begin
      track_ga_event(action,
                     category: "sales_lifecycle",
                     label: order&.id,
                     value: product_name,
                     custom_params: custom_params)
      Rails.logger.info "Sales GA tracking: #{action} for Order ##{order&.id}"
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Sales GA tracking failed for #{action}: #{e.message}"
    end
  end

  # Public method to get GA events for view rendering
  # This provides a clean interface for views to access GA events
  # @return [Array<Hash>] Array of GA event hashes, never nil
  def ga_events_for_rendering
    @ga_events ||= []
  end

  # Backward compatibility method for tests that use assigns(:ga_events)
  # This ensures our refactoring doesn't break existing tests
  # @return [Array<Hash>, nil] Array of GA event hashes or nil if empty
  def ga_events_for_testing
    @ga_events.presence
  end

  private

  # Check if Google Analytics is enabled and not in test environment
  # @return [Boolean] Whether GA tracking should be performed
  def google_analytics_enabled?
    defined?(Rails) &&
    Rails.application.config.respond_to?(:google_analytics_enabled) &&
    Rails.application.config.google_analytics_enabled &&
    !Rails.env.test?
  end
end

module GoogleAnalyticsHelper
  def google_analytics_tag
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    javascript_tag nonce: true do
      <<~JS.html_safe
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
        function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
        gtag('js', new Date());
        gtag('config', '#{google_analytics_id}', {
          page_path: window.location.pathname,
          anonymize_ip: true,
          cookie_flags: 'SameSite=None;Secure',
          user_id: #{current_portal_user ? "'user_#{current_portal_user.id}'" : 'null'}
        });
      JS
    end
  end

  def google_analytics_script_tag
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    javascript_include_tag(
      "https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=#{google_analytics_id}",
      async: true,
      nonce: true
    )
  end

  def google_analytics_enabled?
    Rails.application.config.google_analytics_enabled && !Rails.env.test?
  end

  def google_analytics_id
    Rails.application.config.google_analytics_id
  end

  def track_event(action, category: nil, label: nil, value: nil, **custom_params)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    event_params = {
      event_category: category,
      event_label: label,
      value: value
    }.compact.merge(custom_params)

    javascript_tag nonce: true do
      "gtag('event', '#{action}', #{event_params.to_json});".html_safe
    end
  end

  def track_user_timing(category, variable, value, label: nil)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    timing_params = {
      name: variable,
      value: value,
      event_category: category,
      event_label: label
    }.compact

    javascript_tag nonce: true do
      "gtag('event', 'timing_complete', #{timing_params.to_json});".html_safe
    end
  end

  def track_exception(description, fatal: false)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    javascript_tag nonce: true do
      "gtag('event', 'exception', { description: '#{description}', fatal: #{fatal} });".html_safe
    end
  end

  def track_page_view(page_title: nil, page_location: nil)
    return unless google_analytics_enabled?

    page_params = {
      page_title: page_title || content_for(:title),
      page_location: page_location || request.original_url,
      page_path: request.path
    }.compact

    javascript_tag nonce: true do
      "gtag('event', 'page_view', #{page_params.to_json});".html_safe
    end
  end
end

  include GoogleAnalyticsHelper

  before do
    # Mock GA helper methods to work in test environment
    allow(view).to receive(:google_analytics_enabled?).and_return(true)

    end
  end

  describe 'with ga_events local variable' do
    context 'when ga_events is empty' do
      it 'renders nothing when empty array is passed' do
        render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: []
        expect(rendered).to be_blank
      end

      it 'renders nothing when nil is passed' do
        render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: nil
        expect(rendered).to be_blank
      end
    end

    context 'when ga_events has data' do
      let(:ga_events) do
        [
          {
            action: 'login',
            category: 'authentication',
            label: 'Admin',
            value: nil
          },
          {
            action: 'purchase',
            category: 'ecommerce',
            label: 'ORDER123',
            value: 1000,
            custom_param: 'custom_value'
          }
        ]
      end

      it 'renders GA events with correct parameters' do
        render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: ga_events

        expect(rendered).to include("gtag('event', 'login'")
        expect(rendered).to include('"event_category":"authentication"')
        expect(rendered).to include('"event_label":"Admin"')
        
        expect(rendered).to include("gtag('event', 'purchase'")
        expect(rendered).to include('"event_category":"ecommerce"')
        expect(rendered).to include('"event_label":"ORDER123"')
        expect(rendered).to include('"value":1000')
        expect(rendered).to include('"custom_param":"custom_value"')
      end

      it 'handles events with minimal parameters' do
        minimal_events = [{ action: 'test_action', category: 'test_category' }]
        render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: minimal_events

        expect(rendered).to include("gtag('event', 'test_action'")
        expect(rendered).to include('"event_category":"test_category"')
      end

      it 'separates standard and custom parameters correctly' do
        event_with_custom = [{
          action: 'custom_event',
          category: 'test',
          label: 'test_label',
          value: 42,
          custom_dimension_1: 'dimension_value',
          custom_metric_1: 100
        }]

        render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: event_with_custom

        expect(rendered).to include('"event_category":"test"')
        expect(rendered).to include('"event_label":"test_label"')
        expect(rendered).to include('"value":42')
        expect(rendered).to include('"custom_dimension_1":"dimension_value"')
        expect(rendered).to include('"custom_metric_1":100')
      end
    end
  end

  describe 'Rails best practices compliance' do
    it 'uses local variables instead of instance variables' do
      # This test ensures our refactoring worked
      partial_content = File.read(Rails.root.join('app/views/shared/_ga_events.html.erb'))
      
      # Should not contain any instance variable references
      expect(partial_content).not_to include('@ga_events')
      expect(partial_content).not_to include('@ga_login_success')
      expect(partial_content).not_to include('@ga_signup_success') 
      expect(partial_content).not_to include('@ga_logout')
      
      # Should use local variables
      expect(partial_content).to include('ga_events')
    end

    it 'has proper documentation about usage' do
      partial_content = File.read(Rails.root.join('app/views/shared/_ga_events.html.erb'))
      expect(partial_content).to include("render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events:")
    end
  end

  describe 'graceful degradation' do
    it 'works when GA is disabled' do
      allow(view).to receive(:google_analytics_enabled?).and_return(false)
      allow(view).to receive(:track_event).and_return(nil)

      ga_events = [{ action: 'test', category: 'test' }]
      expect { render 'shared/ga_events', ga_events: ga_events }.not_to raise_error
    end
  end
end
